brief.title: Internal AI Assistant for Law Firm Precedents
brief.summary: A law firm wants a private chat assistant for associates that answers questions using only internal PDFs with page-level citations. The system needs to integrate with SharePoint, handle access control, and be hosted in their Azure tenant.
mustHaves: Ingest PDFs and keep them in sync with SharePoint
Answers with page-level citations and a source link
niceToHaves: Experience with legal or other regulated clients strongly preferred

clientSignals.note: Clear scope and technical requirements defined.
Specific enterprise constraints like Azure hosting and SharePoint sync provided.

questionsToAsk: How are the scanned PDFs currently handled in terms of OCR quality?
What is the expected volume of new documents added to SharePoint weekly or monthly?
What framework or tooling do you prefer for the evaluation of answer quality?

requirements.requirement: Ingest PDFs and keep them in sync with SharePoint
requirements.evidence: Shipped a RAG assistant over 1,200 policy PDFs, but data source was local/direct rather than SharePoint specifically. The general PDF ingestion and syncing skills transfer, but SharePoint integration is new.

requirements.requirement: Answers with page-level citations and a source link
requirements.evidence: Shipped a RAG assistant over 1,200 policy PDFs for an insurance broker: pgvector, citations, an eval set of 150 questions.
Nothing in the profile mentions implementing folder-level or role-based access control lists (ACLs) mapped to SharePoint permissions.
Experienced with cloud hosting (AWS Lambda, RDS, S3, and Vercel), but the specific Azure cloud environment is new; AWS architecture and cloud deployment principles transfer.

proofPoints.claim: Shipped a RAG assistant over 1,200 policy PDFs with pgvector and citations.
proofPoints.whyItMatters: Directly proves ability to build the core document-qa and citation logic required by the law firm.

proofPoints.claim: Built and maintain 20+ n8n and Make automations connecting tools like HubSpot, Slack, and Google Sheets.
proofPoints.whyItMatters: Demonstrates capability to connect third-party document repositories and APIs, which applies to syncing with SharePoint.

gaps.honestFraming: While I have built document sync pipelines and cloud-hosted architectures on AWS, I will adapt these patterns to set up SharePoint ingestion and Azure infrastructure for your tenant.
I can implement document-level metadata filtering in the RAG pipeline to respect your partner-only folder permissions.

fit.angle: I have already built a production RAG assistant with page-level citations over 1,200 PDFs, giving me the exact document-QA expertise needed for your law firm's chat assistant.

versions.proposal:
Your law firm needs a private chat assistant for associates that answers questions using only internal PDFs with page-level citations. The system must integrate with SharePoint, handle access control, and run in your Azure tenant.

I recently shipped a RAG assistant over 1,200 policy PDFs using pgvector, exact citations, and an evaluation set. That project directly covers the document-QA and citation requirements for your precedents.

While my cloud infrastructure experience is on AWS rather than Azure, I will adapt my sync pipelines and cloud architectures to set up your SharePoint ingestion and Azure environment. I will also implement metadata filtering to respect partner-only folder permissions.

First, we will set up the Azure hosting and SharePoint document sync. Second, we will build the RAG pipeline with page-level citations and access controls. Third, we will run answer quality evaluations and refine the outputs.

What specific Azure services or resource groups should we use for the initial deployment?

state.job:
AI assistant over our internal precedents and policies (law firm, ~4,000 PDFs)

We want a private chat assistant for our associates that answers questions using only our documents, with citations to the exact page. It must never answer from general knowledge without saying so.

Requirements:
- Ingest PDFs (some scanned), keep them in sync when we add new ones to SharePoint
- Answers with page-level citations and a link to the source
- Access control: some folders are partner-only
- Hosted in our Azure tenant; we have Azure OpenAI but are open to other models
- Evaluation: we want to measure answer quality before rollout

Hourly, $50-80/hr, ~3 months. Experience with legal or other regulated clients strongly preferred.
state.profile:
Demo profile — replace with your own.

Full-stack & AI developer, 7 years. Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Python.
- Built a booking + reminders system for a 2-location dental practice: online booking, Twilio SMS reminders, Stripe deposits. No-shows fell from 11% to 4% in 3 months.
- Built and maintain 20+ n8n and Make automations for agencies (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Slack, Google Sheets), incl. lead scoring with an LLM.
- Shipped a RAG assistant over 1,200 policy PDFs for an insurance broker: pgvector, citations, an eval set of 150 questions. Answer accuracy went from 71% to 89% after retrieval tuning.
- React Native (Expo) app for a gym chain, 15k installs.
- AWS (Lambda, RDS, S3) and Vercel; CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Based in Canada (Eastern time).
